LOST-LINK / RTH PROCEDURE — rev v1 (SAMPLE DOCUMENT)
Effective: 1 Nov 2026

1. Note last known position and heading.
2. Confirm RTH engages within 10 seconds.
3. Clear the landing zone.
4. If no RTH after 30 seconds, notify the mission commander and prepare manual recovery.
5. File a report after the aircraft is secured.

This is a sample file used to demonstrate revision archiving. Replace with your real procedure.

5eed00000000000000000000000000a2.content:
LOST-LINK / RTH PROCEDURE — rev v2 (SAMPLE DOCUMENT)
Effective: 8 Nov 2026
Change from v1: added dock-based aircraft steps (items 3 and 6).

1. Note last known position and heading.
2. Confirm RTH engages within 10 seconds.
3. For dock-launched aircraft: confirm the dock hatch is open and the pad is clear.
4. Clear the landing zone.
5. If no RTH after 30 seconds, notify the mission commander and prepare manual recovery.
6. For dock-launched aircraft: if the aircraft cannot reach the dock, divert to the alternate pad at the site boundary.
7. File a report after the aircraft is secured.

This is a sample file used to demonstrate revision archiving. Replace with your real procedure.
